Txomin Etxaniz

Txomin Etxaniz

WhiteDesignation of Origin (DO) Getariako Txakolina

White txakoli from Getaria, made from Hondarrabi Zuri, light, very fresh and often slightly spritzy: a Basque coast classic.

Txomin Etxaniz white txakoli is one of the most representative wines of the Getariako Txakolina Designation of Origin. It is made mainly from Hondarrabi Zuri, the native white variety of the Basque coast, with a small proportion of the red Hondarrabi Beltza, from vineyards on the slopes of Getaria facing the Bay of Biscay.

The damp Atlantic climate with mild temperatures yields grapes with high acidity and moderate alcohol. The wine ferments at low temperature in tank and is bottled young, often retaining some of the natural carbon dioxide from fermentation, which gives it a slight spritz.

It is traditionally poured from a height, which heightens its freshness and sparkle. It is a light, dry and saline white, meant to be drunk young, ideally in the year after the harvest.

Tasting profile

Very pale yellow with green highlights and sometimes fine bubbles. Aromas of green apple, citrus, grass and sea-breeze notes. Light, dry and vibrant on the palate, with very lively acidity.

Food pairing

Pintxos, anchovies, shellfish, chargrilled fish, bonito tuna

Serving

7-9 °C, txakoli tumbler or white wine glass; traditionally poured from a height
